question: Should this PR proceed as first-party Control UI math rendering, and if so should it use tracked dependency/build provenance with single-dollar parsing disabled by default?
rationale: The feature is useful, but accepting global math rendering also chooses a user-visible delimiter contract and a same-origin third-party script provenance model that automation should not decide.

options.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
options.body: Require a package/build or owner-approved vendor path and avoid `$...$` default parsing before considering the PR landable.

options.title: Accept approved vendoring
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept a vendored MathJax bundle only with documented source, license, version, update, and review provenance.

options.title: Defer core math rendering
options.body: Pause or close this implementation while keeping the canonical feature request open for a safer markdown-stage design.

recommendation.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
recommendation.body: Require a package/build or owner-approved vendor path and avoid `$...$` default parsing before considering the PR landable.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current and original history across Control UI markdown rendering, chat rendering, and adjacent CSP/security-sensitive surfaces.
